turns.content:
Now I can see the bug! After accessing `is_overlapping` on `tree1`, the `_is_overlapping` attribute is set to `False`. Then when accessing `is_overlapping` on `tree2`, the `_is_overlapping` attribute is also `False`, even though `tree2` should have a different result.

This is because the `cdef readonly` declaration creates a class-level default value for the attribute, and when the attribute is set on one instance, it affects all instances. This is a bug in the Cython code.

Let me verify this theory by checking if the issue is with the `readonly` declaration:
